businessModel: Vertical SaaS for dental practices, 150 employees, $22M ARR

ownerIntake.stage: Growth: $22M ARR (+22% YoY), EBITDA 8% ($1.76M), customer concentration risk: top 10 = 35% of revenue. Net revenue retention 98%, churn 2% quarterly (acceptable).
